name: zdeclient_qsand_build
description: zDEClient_QSand::Build clips the quicksand outline through ClipPatch, normalizes negative results to zero, and adopts returned clip-patch points when generated.
known_limits: The smoke target covers negative ClipPatch normalization and empty-output preservation; generated-point adoption is covered through the accepted ClipPatch output contract and deferred to the coherent zDEClient clip-patch feature pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient quicksand/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456450 validates ClipPatch argument forwarding from the feature instance, result <= 0 handling, negative-result normalization to 0, null output-points return, optional old-points free, adoption of clipPatchOutput->points, pointCount update, and final result return.
The native QSand build smoke verifies null feature inputs through ClipPatch normalize to 0 and a valid empty camera/grid-cell clip returns 0 without replacing the feature point buffer.
